statement_period: Combined relationship statement; each product has its own opening and closing dates and balances
amounts: Amount Subtracted and Amount Added columns plus Balance
layout: CITIBANK ACCOUNTS summary, then a section per product (checking, savings, CDs) with Opening Balance and Closing Balance printed as dated lines; a credit card summary block
what_trips_converters: Balance lines read as transactions; several accounts in one file; a transfer appearing on two accounts; the card summary isn't a card statement
how_zerabooks_reads_it: Printed balance lines are dropped as transactions; each account is proven on its own

statement_period: Rarely a calendar month (e.g. Mar 22 through Apr 21)
layout: Account Summary; Deposits/Credits; Card Withdrawals grouped by card with subtotals; Other Withdrawals; Balance Summary in bands
what_trips_converters: Year missing on every date; trailing minus lost; card subtotals read as transactions
how_zerabooks_reads_it: Year taken from the statement period; trailing minus kept; the Card column shows which debit card

amounts: Amount per block; the block decides the sign
layout: ACCOUNT SUMMARY; DAILY ACCOUNT ACTIVITY split into Deposits, Electronic Deposits, Checks Paid, Electronic Payments, Other Withdrawals, Service Charges; daily balance table
what_trips_converters: Checks Paid listed in number order with an asterisk at a gap; recap tables of checks already listed
how_zerabooks_reads_it: Type from the printed section; Check Number kept; a recap is dropped only when the balance then ties

amounts: Overdrawn balances with a trailing minus ("1,441.08-")
layout: Balance Summary; Overdraft and Returned Item Fee Summary; Deposits and Other Additions; Checks and Other Deductions with item counts; Daily Balance; Activity Detail; Detail of Services Used
what_trips_converters: Fee summary and services tables read as transactions; an overdrawn opening balance read as positive
how_zerabooks_reads_it: Trailing minus on balances kept; summary tables aren't transactions

amounts: Payments and credits printed with a minus
layout: Account summary (Previous Balance, Payments/Credits, New Charges, Fees, Interest, New Balance); a section per card member; Foreign Spend column; travel detail lines
what_trips_converters: Foreign spend and ticket detail lines read as charges; card members' sections mixed together
how_zerabooks_reads_it: Detail lines aren't transactions; proven in total and per card member, with a Cardholder column
